evidence: A fully informed settlement can select Pathways Grade 7, order 96 copies, use individual accounts, include all three language versions, schedule both paid preparation sessions and the August 24 launch, and provide the required commitments with PF1 justified and revealed. The draft settlement is a plausible failing settlement because it uses the Grade 6 edition, 80 copies, shared access, English only, one workshop, and an August 17 launch.
